verdicts.reason: A keeps a sensible brand > headline > subcopy > CTA order, but there is a big dead gap between the tiny phone and SOLSTICE. The headline is jammed against the top edge, and the CTA is the same size as the BACK BY DEMAND pill, so it gets no emphasis; SUMMER ONLY also drifts off to the right edge. B has a stronger headline, but SOLSTICE has shrunk to unreadable size under it, and the subcopy is cut off from the headline and pressed to the top edge. Its CTA and two badges form a cramped 2x2 cluster where SUMMER ONLY is as heavy as the CTA, which muddles both the hierarchy and the reading order.
